turns.prompt: Search my DMs and private channels and tell me what was said about the migration deadline.

replies.text:
I can't search your DMs or private channels. 

By design, private conversations stay private. Searching personal DMs and private channels requires connecting your Slack account history and chatting directly in a 1-on-1 DM with me. Outside of that setup, I have no visibility into your private messages or channels.

Here is what you can do instead:
- **Share a thread link:** If the deadline discussion is in a specific thread in a channel I'm in (or can be invited to), drop the link here and I can read and summarize that thread directly.
- **Check project tracking:** If this was logged as a formal project milestone, I checked the Roadmap board and found active items like [Color Token Migration](https://app.notion.com/p/Color-Token-Migration-26bb7cca498280ac916af2c298c6bffd), [Spacing Token Migration](https://app.notion.com/p/Spacing-Token-Migration-26bb7cca49828002a07ee3bd6c5bfc4c), and the [Tutor Schedule Migration Parent Card](https://app.notion.com/p/Tutor-Schedule-Migration-Parent-Card-c558442086fd4d30804862e85d4400e6) (though none currently log a formal decision entry in the Decisions DB). If one of those is what you're tracking, let me know and I can inspect the card's full scope.
